gallery.description:
Russian Prince (ship)
Wreck of the HMS Russian Prince. Photograph taken at Stieglitz (near Woongoolba) Queensland, in 1910. (Description supplied with photograph). The Walrus, built in 1864 by Taylor Winship at Cleveland, Queensland, run aground on the Albert River 1884. [1] In 1887, a 14 metre flood washed the wreck off the sandbank and downstream to Tippler’s Passage, where the lower portion of the Walrus came to rest, re-named HMS Russian Prince by local children.[2]
categories: Black and white photographs of Australia in the 1910s
